title: Avoid computing retired control payload checksums
outcome: Avoid computing retired control payload checksums
acceptance: Control observation, grant, lease, supersession, operation and policy-operation payload writers use bytes-only canonicalization where no fingerprint consumer remains.
Regression tests compare canonical bytes at runtime and preserve replay, intent and replacement-decision fingerprint comparisons.
Required gates and paired review pass; any performance claim is supported by measurement.

completion.summary: Removed retired control-payload checksum computation by centralizing bytes-only canonicalization, preserved all compared fingerprints and canonical stored bytes, added runtime-derived regression coverage, passed all nine required gates on the exact frozen input, completed paired review with no findings above Low, and recorded the four Low follow-ups requested by Greg.
